passages.text: The existing fixture-hint flow permits up to three requests per core session after prediction. Failed requests still use a request slot. The interface shows requests used separately from hints delivered. Fixture hints are pre-written guidance, not live model output.

When conversational tutoring is enabled, signed-in learners can ask engineering questions and request explanations, debugging suggestions or worked educational examples. The tutor uses the owned lesson's permitted current context and a short recent conversation. Optional code and generated examples are not executed; advice is not a saved verification result. The separate guided-explanation mode still selects pre-written lesson guidance. Neither mode changes saved results, awards competency scores or completes a lesson. Questions, optional code and recent conversation may be sent to Gemini; do not include personal information or secrets. Provider failure or a deadline can make the tutor unavailable while saved learning progress remains unchanged.
